key_insight: A unified DVAE + particle filter framework can learn and track latent weld-pool states robustly across different arc welding processes despite noisy visuals and nonlinear dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable real-time monitoring for welding quality control without heavy process-specific tuning or large labeled datasets.
method: CNN encoder-decoder learns compact latent weld-pool features from images
LSTM transition model captures temporal evolution under control inputs
Particle filter propagates latent and hidden states to suppress noise and preserve process history
evidence_signal: The framework was validated on GTAW and GMAW, showing generalizability and robustness without process-specific tuning.
watch_item: Performance may depend on reliable particle-filter state initialization and sufficient compute for real-time inference in noisy, fast-changing weld scenes.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
